pr_metadata.title: fix(deps): bump urllib3 to 2.8.0 (pip-audit: PYSEC-2026-4175/4176/4177)
pr_metadata.summary: Upgrades urllib3 from 2.7.0 to 2.8.0 in uv.lock to clear three pip-audit vulnerability findings against 2.7.0.
pr_metadata.notes: Lock-only change made with uv lock --upgrade-package urllib3. No other packages moved. uv 0.12.24 also bumped the lockfile revision field from 3 to 5, which is format metadata only. vrg-validate is fully green, and pip-audit reports no known vulnerabilities.
